dct_description_sm:
Point feature layer representing fittings and fixtures upon mains within the water infrastructure in the City of Barrie.
Relevant fields within the layer include (but not limited to): Material, Dates, Status, Location and Type.

The City of Barrie is situated in the heart of Central Ontario, a premier waterfront community on Lake Simcoe, conveniently located an hour north of Toronto.  With a growing population of 143,000 the City of Barrie is the 34th largest city in Canada.  Visit barrie.ca for more information or contact Service Barrie at 705-726-4242 or ServiceBarrie@barrie.ca
